shelves.title: Designs
shelves.blurb: A rule on the corners of a cube, folded into itself, then grown, cropped and counted.

shelves.title: Slices and stacks
shelves.blurb: Meet a design with a plane, or lay it over turned and scaled copies of itself.

shelves.title: Words and order
shelves.blurb: Let the rule change with the scale, and read what the order of the letters costs.

shelves.title: Graphs, walks and spectra
shelves.blurb: Join the filled cells and listen: the network, its spectrum, and the walk it carries.

shelves.title: Primes in the lattice
shelves.blurb: Where the primes fall once the whole numbers are laid out on a grid.

shelves.title: Fractions and zeros
shelves.blurb: Rational scales and the critical line, both counting the primes the long way.

shelves.title: The ledger
shelves.blurb: Every sequence the designs write, every integer they reach, and rules read out of the registry.

pages.name: universe
pages.title: The universe
pages.blurb: Rotations and reflections fold the corner masks of a hypercube into orbits, so the distinct designs of dimensions 1 to 4 are a finite gallery you can grow one by one.

pages.name: sponge
pages.title: The sponge
pages.blurb: A code picks the filled corners of a cube and grows it level by level, with fills, voids and exposed faces answered by closed formulas before a cube is built.

pages.name: tile
pages.title: The tile
pages.blurb: One design repeated: side by side on the square lattice in the plane and in the cube, interlocked as a hexagon on the triangular one, where the fills multiply by the copy count exactly and the exposed faces do not.

pages.name: crop
pages.title: The crop
pages.blurb: A named shape of rational radius keeps only the cells of a design it reaches, with the in, cut and out regions counted exactly before anything is drawn.

pages.name: tour
pages.title: The tour
pages.blurb: A dozen cards, each drawing a design live beside the integer sequence it counts and the OEIS record that holds the terms.

pages.name: mrlylife
pages.title: mrlylife
pages.blurb: Life with the neighbourhood set free: the mask is a design at any side and level, the birth and survival counts come by hand or from a named sequence, and the board runs in one dimension or two.

pages.name: wolfram
pages.title: The rules
pages.blurb: Wolfram's 256 elementary rules are the 256 three-dimensional parity designs bit for bit, so every rule arrives with a design's card, and the additive rules draw the plane designs in time.

pages.name: cuts
pages.title: The cuts
pages.blurb: Every plane x + y + z = s through a level-L solid meets exactly 3^L cells, and the height's binary digits make each cut a Sierpinski gasket.

pages.name: slices
pages.title: The slices
pages.blurb: The central diagonal cut of a cube of odd side n = 2k-1 is a regular hexagon of 6n^2 unit triangles, and a design's parity rule fills them into many pieces or one pierced piece as k alternates.

pages.name: spectrometer
pages.title: The spectrometer
pages.blurb: The inked share of the diagonal slice is an exact closed form in a design's Walsh spectrum, so the hexagon's two-step blink over the odd sides reads the eight-corner recipe back.

pages.name: volume
pages.title: The volume
pages.blurb: The moire stack of a cube design as a solid field, shelled at a level set and cut on any plane, where the central diagonal cut is the hexagon.

pages.name: tower
pages.title: The tower
pages.blurb: The tile held to one axis with the word rising a letter per block, where a block's fill fraction falls geometrically and its exposed count climbs, so the volume converges while the surface diverges.

pages.name: carry
pages.title: The carry
pages.blurb: The diagonal cut of a base-q sponge remembers only a carry, so ceil(D/2) past terms decide every count and the growth exponent misses the generic value, above it at odd dimensions and below it at even ones.

pages.name: moire
pages.title: Moire
pages.blurb: One design sampled at scale 1, 3, 5 and on, the layers stacked into a field where the interference is the finer grids landing on the coarse.

pages.name: radial
pages.title: The radial stack
pages.blurb: Turned copies of a design laid on each other keep only the circular harmonics whose order is a multiple of the copy count, and a design of rotation order g shows lcm(q, g) petals.

pages.name: spin
pages.title: The spin
pages.blurb: A design on a turntable strobed against the frame rate, beside the exact circle mean at every radius, which is the bullseye it becomes at infinite speed.

pages.name: words
pages.title: The words
pages.blurb: One design per level folded by the Kronecker product, with the census, the component exponent, and what changes when the letters swap places.

pages.name: morse
pages.title: The Thue-Morse word
pages.blurb: The Thue-Morse word built twice from one digit rule, lifted to four plane grids of which three are Kronecker powers of a plus-minus tile and one is not, with its runs and its boundary word.

pages.name: graphs
pages.title: The graphs
pages.blurb: Joining every filled cell to its neighbours turns a design into a network with tips, junctions, pieces, length and a box dimension, flat, in the cube, on the hexagonal slice, or relaxed by force.

pages.name: spectra
pages.title: The spectra
pages.blurb: The normalised Laplacian of a design's graph puts a third of the Sierpinski triangle's spectrum on the single eigenvalue 1, and the slope of the low end reads the random-walk spectral dimension.

pages.name: race
pages.title: The race
pages.blurb: Two base-3 designs of the same mass and the same fractal dimension carry random walkers from home at different speeds, so the shape sets the walk, not the density.

pages.name: primes
pages.title: The primes
pages.blurb: A number is prime when its stones make one rectangle, shown by the sieve, the divisor pairs, the pi(x) staircase against x / ln x and li(x), and a carpet stack whose layers correlate to zero exactly at the primes.

pages.name: ulam
pages.title: The Ulam spiral
pages.blurb: The whole numbers wound on squares or hexagons with the primes lit, where every straight line reads a quadratic and the prime-rich ones stand out as diagonals.

pages.name: gaussian
pages.title: Primes in the plane
pages.blurb: The Gaussian and Eisenstein primes as four- and six-armed snowflakes, coloured by whether an ordinary prime split, stayed inert, or ramified on entering the plane.

pages.name: farey
pages.title: The Farey stack
pages.blurb: A line drawn at every k/n and stacked over the scales lights a reduced fraction a/b to a brightness of Q/b, and the scales of maximal novelty are the primes.

pages.name: zeta
pages.title: The critical line
pages.blurb: Zeta walked at s = 1/2 + it passes through the origin once per zero, and the zeros added one at a time fold a smooth curve into the prime staircase.

pages.name: sequences
pages.title: The sequences
pages.blurb: The searchable ledger of every integer sequence the designs write, with closed forms and the OEIS entry each one matches.

pages.name: plot
pages.title: The plot
pages.blurb: Any sequence the ledger holds drawn rather than listed, with the smallest linear recurrence its terms satisfy, its characteristic polynomial and its growth read out beside it, and a second sequence mixed in to see the rule a blend inherits.

pages.name: integers
pages.title: The integers
pages.blurb: The union of every sequence the registry writes, read integer by integer: which of the first thousand the designs write, how many rows write each, and which are missed inside the pinned window.

pages.name: life
pages.title: Conway's Life
pages.blurb: Conway's rule on the eight cells around, which are the side-3 carpet tile with its centre popped, seeded by soup, glider or R-pentomino and run to its fate.
